get.summary:
List who may do what: each grant of an action to a role, within a scope. Filter by
`role`, `resource` or `action` (exact), paginated, ordered by resource, action and role
unless `sort` says otherwise (repeat it to sort by several keys, `-` prefix for
descending). A grant marked `stale` names an action or scope its module no longer has,
and allows nothing. `403` unless the caller is an `admin`, or holds a role granted it.

503.description: Not ready to answer yet: retry later.

post.summary:
Grant a role an action on a resource, within a scope (`any` unless given), taking effect
on every server instance within 5 seconds. The role must exist (`list_roles`), and the
resource, action and scope must be in the catalog (`get_access_catalog`), else `400`
names the field at fault; a grant equal to an
existing one is refused with `409`. `403` unless the caller is an `admin`, or holds a role granted it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters, unique per request: a retry with the same key and request within 24 hours gets the first successful answer replayed instead of running again.

422.description: This `Idempotency-Key` was sent with a different request.

delete.summary:
Revoke a grant, taking effect on every server instance within 5 seconds. Requires
`If-Match` with the version listed; a stale value is refused with `412`. A module's
default grant, once revoked, isn't granted again by a later deploy. No revocation
removes `admin`'s own access to these operations. `403` unless the caller is an `admin`, or holds a role granted it.

each action with the operations performing it and whether anything in force could allow

get.summary:
List the roles grants can be made to, each with its description and whether it is built
in (`admin` and `user`, which can't be deleted). Paginated, ordered by name unless `sort`
says otherwise (`name` or `createdAt`, `-` prefix for descending). `403` unless the caller
is an `admin`, or holds a role granted it.

Create a role, so grants can be made to it. Its name is its id and can't be changed
later; a name a role already has is refused with `409`, and an empty one with `400`
naming `name`. `403` unless the caller is an `admin`, or holds a role granted it.

`412`. A built-in role (`admin`, `user`), or one a grant still names, is refused with

granted it.

get.summary:
List the subjects roles can be assigned to (each a token's `sub`): everyone who has
signed in, with their name and email when their token carried them and when they were
last seen (to within an hour), and anyone assigned a role or in `APP_BOOTSTRAP_ADMINS`
who hasn't signed in yet. Each comes with the roles it holds beside `user`, and each
role with the version `unassign_role` takes; a bootstrap admin is marked `bootstrapAdmin`
and holds `admin`, which can't be unassigned. `search` matches part of the subject, name
or email, in any case. Paginated, ordered by subject unless `sort` says otherwise
(`subject`, `name`, `email` or `lastSeen`, `-` prefix for descending). `403` unless the
caller is an `admin`, or holds a role granted it.

503.description: Not ready to answer yet: retry later.

post.summary:
Assign a role to a subject (the token's `sub`), whether or not they have signed in yet.
They hold it, beside `user`, on every server instance within 5 seconds; the token's own
claims never give roles. `user`, which every signed-in user holds, is refused with `400`
naming `role`, as is a role that doesn't exist (`list_roles`, `create_role`); a role the
subject holds already is refused with `409`. `403` unless the caller is an `admin`, or
holds a role granted it.

delete.summary:
Unassign a role from a subject, taking effect on every server instance within 5 seconds.
Requires `If-Match` with the version `assign_role` answered; a stale value is refused with
`412`, and `404` when the subject doesn't hold that role by assignment. `user` is refused
with `400` naming `role`. `admin` is refused with `409` for a bootstrap admin
(`APP_BOOTSTRAP_ADMINS`), who always holds it, and for the last subject assigned it when
there are no bootstrap admins, so admins can't lock themselves out. `403` unless the caller
is an `admin`, or holds a role granted it.

AddItemRequest.title: AddItemRequest
AddItemRequest.description: Adds a line to a note's checklist. Like an edit, it carries no version.

AssignmentRequest.title: AssignmentRequest
AssignmentRequest.description: A role to assign to a subject.

subject.description: Whom to assign it to: the token's `sub`, whether or not they have signed in yet.

role.description: A role that exists (`list_roles`), never `user`, which every signed-in user holds.

assignedBy.description: Who assigned it; absent for one a seed assigned.

version.description: Echo it back in `If-Match` to unassign the role.

operations.description: The operations performing it, by operation id.

reachable.description: False when no rule or grant in force could allow it to anyone.

module.description: The module whose resource it is.

scopes.description: What a grant of it may be scoped to: `any` first, then the resource's own.

CatalogResponse.title: CatalogResponse
CatalogResponse.description: What admins grant from: every module's gate and resources.

ChangeDisplayNameRequest.title: ChangeDisplayNameRequest
ChangeDisplayNameRequest.description:
Request body for changing the current user's display name. Carries no
version: the concurrency token travels only in the `If-Match` header.

archiveAt.description:
When to archive the note (RFC 3339), if ever: from then on it is
read-only. A time already past archives it at once.

CreateUserRequest.title: CreateUserRequest
CreateUserRequest.description: Request body for creating a user.

EditNoteRequest.title: EditNoteRequest
EditNoteRequest.description:
Replaces a note's title, body and `archiveAt`: one left out is cleared,
cancelling the archive. Carries no version: the concurrency token travels
only in the `If-Match` header, never the body (see the handlers).

archiveAt.description:
When to archive the note (RFC 3339), if ever; a new time reschedules
it, and a time already past archives it at once. Send back the one read
to keep it.

requestId.description: The same id as the `x-request-id` header.

traceId.description: The W3C trace id of the request; absent when tracing is off.

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description: One input at fault. `path` names it as the client sent it (e.g. `title`).

GrantRequest.title: GrantRequest
GrantRequest.description:
A role granted an action on a resource, within a scope. The role must exist (`list_roles`);
the resource, action and scope must be in the catalog (`get_access_catalog`).

resource.description: A module's gate (`module:<name>`, whose only action is `use`) or one of its resources.

scope.description: `any` (every row), or one of the resource's scopes. A gate takes only `any`.

grantedBy.description: Who granted it; absent for a module's default grant, applied when it was deployed.

stale.description:
Its module's policies no longer have its resource, action or scope (a later release
removed it), so it allows nothing: revoke it.

version.description: Echo it back in `If-Match` to revoke this grant.

ListResult_GrantResponse.title: ListResult_GrantResponse
ListResult_GrantResponse.description: The paging fields are present only when the list was paged.

ListResult_NoteResponse.title: ListResult_NoteResponse
ListResult_NoteResponse.description: The paging fields are present only when the list was paged.

ListResult_NoteSummaryResponse.title: ListResult_NoteSummaryResponse
ListResult_NoteSummaryResponse.description: The paging fields are present only when the list was paged.

ListResult_RoleResponse.title: ListResult_RoleResponse
ListResult_RoleResponse.description: The paging fields are present only when the list was paged.

ListResult_SubjectResponse.title: ListResult_SubjectResponse
ListResult_SubjectResponse.description: The paging fields are present only when the list was paged.

ListResult_UserResponse.title: ListResult_UserResponse
ListResult_UserResponse.description: The paging fields are present only when the list was paged.

archiveAt.description: When the note is due to archive itself, as its author chose.

archivedAt.description:
When the note was archived: at its `archiveAt`, or because its author
was deleted. An archived note can't be edited or deleted.

items.description:
Its checklist, in the order the items were added. An item is part of
the note: changing one changes the note's version.

version.description:
Optimistic-concurrency version. Echo it back in `If-Match` to edit this
note; a stale value is refused with `412 Precondition Failed`. Also
mirrored in the `ETag` response header for single-item reads.

authorName.description: The author's display name; absent when no user has the note's author id.

RoleRequest.title: RoleRequest
RoleRequest.description: A role to create: its name is its id, which grants name and which can't be changed.

description.description: What the role is for, for the admins granting it.

createdBy.description: Who created it; absent for a built-in role, or one created for a module's default grants.

version.description: Echo it back in `If-Match` to delete this role.

SubjectResponse.title: SubjectResponse
SubjectResponse.description:
Someone roles can be assigned to: a subject seen signing in, or one assigned a role or made a
bootstrap admin before it ever has, which has no name, email or sightings.

name.description: From the token's `name` claim, when it carried one.

email.description: From the token's `email` claim, when it carried one.

firstSeen.description: When it first signed in; absent if it never has.

lastSeen.description: When it last signed in, accurate to within an hour; absent if it never has.

bootstrapAdmin.description:
In `APP_BOOTSTRAP_ADMINS`: it holds `admin` whatever is assigned, and it can't be
unassigned.

roles.description: The roles it holds beside `user`, which every signed-in user holds, by name.

version.description:
The assignment's version: echo it back in `If-Match` to unassign the role. Absent for a
bootstrap admin's `admin` that isn't also assigned, which can't be unassigned.

UserResponse.title: UserResponse
UserResponse.description:
A user as exposed over HTTP. Ids and timestamps are strings so the generated
client stays dependency-free (uuid/RFC3339 as plain `string`).

version.description:
Optimistic-concurrency version. Echo it back in `If-Match` to change this
user; a stale value is refused with `412 Precondition Failed`. Also
mirrored in the `ETag` response header for single-item reads.

JwtAuth.description:
JWT Bearer security scheme: the token verified, then resolved to the [`Principal`] acting. A
Module's operations take its `Caller` instead, which passes its gate too.
